race.comment: CARNEVALE (2) sets the standard after two solid runs this campaign, placing at this track before going under by only half a length to Celtic Spy at Swan Hill. He was again respected in betting there, has race fitness on his side third-up, and the step up in trip should be of little concern.. CIPHERED (3) resumed with a sound third at Kyneton and had to wait for room past the 200m, so there is scope for that run to read better than the margin. TALE OF GENJI (12) made a good first impression when third at Moe, beaten a length after picking up from back in the field, and she looks a natural improver up in trip. FIVE ROSES (8) debuts for the Hayes yard after three trials and has enough family and stable profile to be a genuine place threat first time out, watch betting.
